This article is about booking time off for a member of staff. Everything below is done from Time off, and you need to be a manager or the owner of the account to see the page at all.

1. Open Time off and choose the name from the list on the left.
2. Pick the first and the last day from the calendar.
3. Choose full days or half days, and whether it comes off the allowance or is unpaid.
4. Press Save; it goes to whoever manages that venue for approval.

It applies from today forward. Anything that has already gone through is left as it was.

Booking it yourself as a manager does not approve it. It still sits in the requests list until somebody with approval rights presses the button, which is deliberate so two managers do not let the same week go twice.

articles.title: Cancelling time off that was already approved
articles.body:
We rewrote this page after a busy first week of the month, when we were asked about cancelling time off that was already approved a dozen times in three days. Start at Time off.

- Open the booking from the staff record and press Cancel.
- Say whether the days go back on the allowance; they do by default.
- Confirm, and the block comes off the rota for those days.

Nothing here happens overnight or on a timer. It is done when the page says it is done.

Cancelling frees the days but does not put any shifts back. Whatever you took off the rota when the holiday was approved has to be rota'd again by hand.

articles.title: Carrying holiday into next year
articles.body:
This page covers carrying holiday into next year from start to finish. It lives under Settings > Time off.

1. Open Settings > Time off and set how many days may be carried.
2. Set the date by which carried days must be taken, if you have one.
3. On the first day of the new year, anything left up to that limit moves across.

The rest of the team carry on working while you do this. Nothing is taken offline.

This is one of the few things an owner can do that a manager cannot, so it may need somebody else in the building.

If you look after more than one venue this is set per venue and is not shared between them, so it is worth doing at each site in one sitting.

The carry happens once, overnight on the first day of the new holiday year. Changing the limit after that does not go back and redo it, so anybody you have missed has to be adjusted on their own record.

articles.title: Correcting an allowance halfway through the year
articles.body:
People write in about correcting an allowance halfway through the year most in the first week of the month, when everybody is publishing. The page is Time off.

1. Open the staff record and set the override under Allowance.
2. Add an adjustment line instead if you only want to give or take a day or two.
3. Save, and the figure they see changes the next time they open the app.

The rest of the team carry on working while you do this. Nothing is taken offline.

If what you are looking at does not seem right, check the date range at the top of the page first. Nine times out of ten it is sitting on the wrong week.

An adjustment line stays on the record with your name and the date on it, which is the version to use when you want to be able to explain it later.

articles.title: Holiday owed to somebody leaving
articles.body:
Here is what we tell people who write in about holiday owed to somebody leaving. Start at Time off and work down the page.

1. Mark them as a leaver with their last day.
2. Open their time off page and read the figure marked Owed at leaving.
3. It is the allowance earned up to the last day, less what they have taken.

It applies from today forward. Anything that has already gone through is left as it was.

It is worth writing down what you have set, because the next person to look after this will ask.

The figure can be negative if somebody has taken more than they had earned by the time they left, and the page says so in words rather than showing a minus sign.

articles.title: How many people you let off at once
articles.body:
A couple of the steps below depend on how your venue settings are set, so have those to hand before you start. The page is Settings > Time off.

- Open Settings > Time off and set the most people who may be off on any one day.
- Set it per role if your kitchen and your floor need counting separately.
- Requests that would take you over show a warning to whoever is approving.

Anything you change here goes into the account history with your name and the time against it, so there is always a record of who did what.

If you are not sure whether something saved, the account history under Settings lists the last ninety days with a name against every line.

It warns, it does not refuse, because a manager often knows a week is quiet. The warning names who else is off so you can decide without leaving the page.

articles.title: Pro rata allowance for part-time staff
articles.body:
Here is what to do about pro rata allowance for part-time staff, step by step. You will find the page at Time off.

1. Put the contracted hours on the staff record.
2. Tick Work out pro rata on the same record.
3. The allowance shows as a share of the venue standard, to the nearest half day.

You can come back and change it later. Nothing on this page is set once and for all.

Somebody who joins partway through the holiday year gets their allowance worked out from their start date as well, so both reductions apply to the same person.

articles.title: Recording sickness
articles.body:
The short version of recording sickness is below. The note at the bottom is worth reading as well as the steps.

1. Open the staff record and press Add absence rather than booking time off.
2. Choose Sickness, set the days and add a note if you need one.
3. Sickness comes off the rota but never off the holiday allowance.

It applies from today forward. Anything that has already gone through is left as it was.

If you want somebody here to do it with you on the phone, the desk is open weekdays from eight until six.

Sickness on a day somebody was rota'd leaves the shift showing as needing cover, which is what puts it in front of whoever is filling the week.

articles.title: Setting your holiday year
articles.body:
The short version of setting your holiday year is below. The note at the bottom is worth reading as well as the steps.

1. Open Settings > Time off and set the month your holiday year starts.
2. Most venues use January or April; it does not have to match your financial year.
3. Save, and the allowance figures redraw against the new year.

The change saves as you make it, and a confirmation runs along the top of the screen. If that confirmation does not appear, nothing has been written down.

If what you are looking at does not seem right, check the date range at the top of the page first. Nine times out of ten it is sitting on the wrong week.

If you look after more than one venue this is set per venue and is not shared between them, so it is worth doing at each site in one sitting.

Changing the month partway through leaves everybody with a short year, and the allowance is worked out pro rata for it. It is worth doing at the end of a year rather than the middle.

articles.title: The allowance a member of staff sees left
articles.body:
This article is about the allowance a member of staff sees left. Everything below is done from Time off, and you need to be a manager or the owner of the account to see the page at all.

1. They open the app, tap You, then Time off.
2. The figure is the allowance less what is approved and less what is taken.
3. Requests waiting on a manager are shown separately underneath.

What you are looking at is live rather than a snapshot, so a refresh gives you the newest version of it.

Nothing on this page is worked out overnight; it is right as at the moment you open it.

The figure counts the whole holiday year, including days later in the year they have already booked, which is why it can look lower than somebody expects in the spring.

articles.title: The holiday allowance for a venue
articles.body:
Here is what we tell people who write in about the holiday allowance for a venue. Start at Settings > Time off and work down the page.

1. Open Settings > Time off and set the standard allowance for the venue.
2. Choose whether you are counting in days or in hours before you enter the figure.
3. Override it on any individual staff record where somebody has a different deal.

Give it a moment on venue wifi. The page catches up on its own and there is no need to do it twice.

Nothing on this page is worked out overnight; it is right as at the moment you open it.

The same page looks slightly different on the older layout. The buttons are in the same order, they are just along the top rather than down the side.

Changing the venue allowance does not touch anybody who already has an override on their record, which is how a long-serving member of staff keeps their extra days when you change the standard.

articles.title: Time off for somebody who works at two venues
articles.body:
This page covers time off for somebody who works at two venues from start to finish. It lives under Time off.

1. Book it once, from either venue; it blocks both.
2. The days come off one allowance, because the allowance belongs to the person.
3. Both sets of managers see the booking on their own rota.

Nothing here happens overnight or on a timer. It is done when the page says it is done.

It is easier on a laptop than on a phone, because there is more room on the screen.

The request itself goes only to the managers of their main venue, so the other site finds out when the booking lands on the rota rather than being asked first.

articles.title: Time off that lands on a bank holiday
articles.body:
Here is what we tell people who write in about time off that lands on a bank holiday. Start at Settings > Rotas and work down the page.

1. Check that the day is marked as observed under Settings > Rotas first.
2. Book the time off as normal across the dates you want.
3. Observed bank holidays inside the booking are skipped and not counted.

Anything you change here goes into the account history with your name and the time against it, so there is always a record of who did what.

This is one of the few things an owner can do that a manager cannot, so it may need somebody else in the building.

If the day is not marked as observed it counts as an ordinary day and comes off the allowance, which is the most common reason somebody says their allowance is a day out.

articles.title: Turning a holiday request down
articles.body:
Managers ask us about turning a holiday request down more than almost anything else, so here it is in full. You will find it under Time off.

1. Open the request and press Decline.
2. Write a line saying why; the member of staff sees exactly what you type.
3. The days go back on their allowance straight away.

If two of you are in the same page at once, the last one to save wins, so it is worth saying out loud who is doing it.

Everything here can be undone from the same page, so it is worth trying it out on a quiet day before you lean on it.

A declined request cannot be approved afterwards. If you change your mind, ask them to put it in again, or book it for them from the same page.

articles.title: Unpaid leave
articles.body:
This is our page on unpaid leave. The screens sit in slightly different places on a phone, but the order of the steps is the same either way.

- Book it the same way as holiday and choose Unpaid for the type.
- The days block the rota and show on the year, but do not touch the allowance.
- Unpaid days are left out of the hours that go to payroll.

Whoever it affects is told by email, and the email says who made the change.

Most venues set this up in their first fortnight and then leave it alone from one year to the next.

Unpaid leave still counts towards the how many people are off at once figure, because the venue is a body down either way.

articles.title: Who a holiday request goes to
articles.body:
This is our page on who a holiday request goes to. The screens sit in slightly different places on a phone, but the order of the steps is the same either way.

1. A request goes to the managers of the venue on that person's staff record.
2. Check the venue on the record if requests are landing with the wrong person.
3. Add or remove managers for a venue under Settings > Permissions.

You are asked to confirm before anything is changed for good, and the confirmation says in plain words what is about to happen.

If you want somebody here to do it with you on the phone, the desk is open weekdays from eight until six.

On a phone, turn it sideways. The columns fit much better that way.

Somebody who works at two venues sends their requests to the managers of the venue marked as their main one, not to both.

tickets.subject: What happens when a document expires?
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, A visa on one of the staff records runs out in three weeks and I want to know what the system does. He has applied for the new one already. I do not want him coming off the rota automatically. We are on venue, if that matters at all. I have written it out as best I can, tell me what else you need. Thanks so much.

Kind regards,
Kofi
tickets.reply: Hi Kofi, nothing happens on the date. Nobody comes off the rota and no shift is refused; the record shows the expiry in red and you get the reminders. Upload the new document when it comes and the old one stays underneath as history. Zach

tickets.subject: Leaver still on the rota
tickets.message:
Hello again, Somebody who left in August is still coming up when I build the rota. I do not want to delete her in case we need the records. She is also still on the bill by the look of it. It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. It is only a handful of people affected out of the whole team, and the ones it is affecting are all part time, in case that narrows it down at all. Let me know when you can.
Sami

tickets.subject: Changing a rate from a date
tickets.message:
Hi, I gave somebody a rise from the Wednesday and the whole week has gone through at the new rate. It is only about eleven pounds but I would rather it were right. Payroll has not run yet so I can still fix it. It is only thirty-seven of us at this site. Sorry if I have missed something obvious.
Rehan
tickets.reply: Hi Rehan, I have sent you Different rates at different venues, which covers exactly this. Give it a go and let me know how you get on. Dot

tickets.subject: Somebody on twice
tickets.message:
Hi team, It let me put one of the girls on a bar shift and a kitchen shift at the same time and did not say anything. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. Any help appreciated.
Struan
tickets.reply: Hi Struan, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: The warning when somebody is on twice. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Lena

tickets.subject: Push notifications
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Nobody gets a notification when I publish. They only find out if they open the app. They are mostly on android. I have checked and notifications are on in their settings. It is the same on the tablet behind the bar. I have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. Many thanks.

Kind regards,
Zeynep
tickets.reply: Hi Zeynep, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Stopping rota emails going out at night. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Marcus

tickets.subject: Holiday request stuck
tickets.message:
Hello again, There is a holiday request sat in my list and the approve button does nothing when I press it. He works at both venues if that makes a difference. I can approve everybody else's, it is just his. We have six on the books here. It is only six of us at this site. No rush on this one.
Tess
tickets.reply: Hi Tess, his main venue is the second site, so the request belongs to the managers there and your button is showing but not yours to press. I have added you as a manager at both venues, which is what you want anyway. Ben

tickets.subject: cannot approve a request
tickets.message:
Hello again, There is a holiday request sat in my list adn the approve button does nothing when I press it. I can approve everybody else's, it is just his. He works at both venues if that makes a difference. I should say the same thing happened a while back as well and it sorted itself out before I got round to writing in, so I do not know whether the two are connected. There are fifteen of us on the books at the moment. No rush on this one.
Ines
tickets.reply: Hello Ines, the request ran across dates you have blocked for the first week of December, and the approve was refusing quietly rather than saying so. That is ours and it is on the list to fix. I have approved it from this end. Quinn

tickets.subject: rise from the Wednesday
tickets.message:
Hi there, How do I change a rate from a particular day rather than from now? Payroll has not run yet so I can still fix it. It is only about eleven pounds but I would rather it were right. Not urgent but it is getting annoying.
Diego

tickets.subject: Cannot sign in to the app
tickets.message:

Hello Hollins, Somebody has left a shift open since Saturday night adn it is throwing the week out! I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. Can I just type the right time in? I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Whenever somebody has five minutes is fine, we are quiet until Thursday. Not urgent but it is getting annoying. Sorry to be brief.
Lewis
tickets.reply: Hello Lewis, approving it is not a problem, you just have to reopen the week first. Press Reopen at the top, fix the Saturday, then approve it again. The period is not locked so there is nothing stopping you. Cal

tickets.subject: Copying a week between venues
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, We run two sites and the rota is nearly the same at both. Can I copy a week from one to the other rather than typing it twice? Whenever you have a minute.

Kind regards,
Ola
tickets.reply: Hi Ola, copy week works within a venue rather than across two, but a template saved as the shape only does exactly what you want. Save one off your main site and apply it at the other, then drop the names on. Marcus

tickets.subject: Re: worked and rota'd are six apart
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Worked hours and rota'd hours are six apart this week and I cannot see why. Nobody has told me they stayed late. It has been right every other week since we started. There is no hurry on this at all. We have fourteen on the books here. Whenever you have a minute.
Nadia
tickets.reply: Hi Nadia, the worked column is what goes to payroll. The six hours are three people clocking out between twenty and forty minutes after their shift on the Saturday. The clock-ins are on the lines if you want to look before you approve it. Una

tickets.subject: forgot to clock out

Hello again, One of the chefs forgot to clock out on Friday and his shift is still showing as running. It says forty one hours. I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. Can I just type the right time in? Whenever you get to it is fine. Whenever you get to it is fine. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

tickets.reply: Hello Verity, approving it is not a problem, you just have to reopen the week first. Press Reopen at the top, fix the Saturday, then approve it again. The period is not locked so there is nothing stopping you. Rosa

I have looked twice and I am sure I am not imagining it. I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. Not urgent but it is getting annoying. Short one, sorry, we are slammed.

Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Kind regards,
Nadia
tickets.reply: Hello Nadia, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Overtime and how it is counted walks through it step by step. Yasmin

ines
tickets.reply: Hello Ines, yes, you can pay it now: open Settings > Billing and press Retry against the failed line. If the bank blocked it as a new payee it usually goes through on the second try once you have told them to expect it. Hana

Hi there, How do I let somebody carry five days into next year? We have always allowed up to five days. I do not want it to just disappear on the first. Cheers.
Isobel
tickets.reply: Hi Isobel, I have set your carry limit to five days, so anything left up to that moves across on the first on its own. Nothing will be lost. If you want a date by which the carried days have to be used, say so and I will put that on too. Aisha

tickets.subject: closing for the season
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Seasonal place, nobody on the rota until spring. What are the options other than cancelling and starting again? We did this last year by email and it worked fine. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Our general manager is on leave so it has landed with me. Thanks, as always.

Kind regards,
Brid

tickets.subject: clash warning did not show
tickets.message:
Morning, It let me put one of the girls on a bar shift and a kitchen shift at the same time and did not say anything. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. She works at both of our sites which might be why. My assistant manager has tried it as well and gets exactly the same. It has been like this for three or four days now. Any steer welcome.
Kofi
tickets.reply: Hi Kofi, the warning was there but it is on the other venue's rota, not yours, because the second shift was at the second site. It is a red corner on that week. I have shortened the kitchen shift by two hours so the two no longer overlap. Nico

tickets.subject: Right to work document running out
tickets.message:
hi, i have had a reminder that somebody's document expires next month. what happens if i do nothing? he has applied for the new one already. i do not want him coming off the rota automatically. i have asked our area manager and she did not know either. there are two of us who do the rota so it may be worth telling us both. many thanks.
fraser
tickets.reply: Hi Fraser, nothing happens on the date. Nobody comes off the rota and no shift is refused; the record shows the expiry in red and you get the reminders. Upload the new document when it comes and the old one stays underneath as history. Rosa

tickets.subject: payment failed email
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, I have had an email saying the payment failed. The card is fine as far as I know. The bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. Can I pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? It is happening every time, not now and then. It has been like this for three or four days now. Hope that makes sense.
Joss

tickets.subject: Push notifications
tickets.message:
Hi, Half the team get the push and half do not. I have checked and notifications are on in their settings. They are mostly on android. It is the same whether I do it on the laptop or on my phone. Appreciate it.
Zeynep

tickets.subject: Can I reuse a week at both sites
tickets.message:
Good morning, Is there a way of building one week and using it at both venues? The staff are different at each but the shape of the week is identical. Many thanks.
Kofi
tickets.reply: Hello Kofi, this article is the one you want: Running rotas for more than one venue. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Wren

tickets.subject: app not working on an old phone
tickets.message:
Hi, The app will not install on one of the team's phones, it says it is not compatible! Is there anything else he can use? He does not want a new phone and I do not blame him. Whatever you can tell me is more than I know at the moment. It is the same whether I do it on the laptop or on my phone. Many thanks. Short one, sorry, we are slammed.
Rehan
tickets.reply: Hello Rehan, nothing he can do about the app itself, but bookmark the website on his home screen and it behaves much like the app. He will see his rota the moment it is published, same as everybody else. Ivy

tickets.subject: Still not sorted: Saturday shifts have gone
tickets.message:
Hello, Half of Saturday has vanished off the rota! There were six people on and now there are two. Is there any way of seeing what it looked like before? My assistant manger was editing at the same time so it may be that. Sorry, one hand on the phone. I had a reply before but it did not fix it, so here it is again with more detail.
Delphine
tickets.reply: Hello Delphine, four shifts were deleted on Friday evening from the same sign-in as yours. I have put all four back and left the rest of the week alone. Worth locking the week once it is right, so nobody can move it after you. Jonah

tickets.subject: Can we pause the account
tickets.message:
hello hollins, we shut for six or seven weeks while it is quiet. can we pause the account rather than pay for it? we would want the rotas still there when we come back. it is six weeks, maybe seven. my area manager is asking about it, which is really why i am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that i can forward on to her. please can somebody have a look.
zeynep
tickets.reply: Hi Zeynep, have a look at Clocking in on the venue tablet, it covers the same ground and should get you moving. Give me a shout if you are still stuck after it. Cerys

tickets.message:

Can I put the day back on without deleting the booking? It is only a handful of people affected out of the whole team, and the ones it is affecting are all part time, in case that narrows it down at all. Any steer welcome. Sorry, one hand on the phone.
Hugo
tickets.reply: Hello Hugo, Adding a member of staff is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Sana

tickets.subject: bank holiday came off the allowance
tickets.message:

It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. Hope that makes sense.
Ola

Kind regards,
Dan

Delphine

tickets.reply: Hi Meera, no bother at all. Have a read of Overtime and how it is counted and follow it through from the top. It catches most people out in the same place, about halfway down. Abe

Anton
tickets.reply: Hi Anton, no bother at all. Have a read of What managers can see and follow it through from the top. It catches most people out in the same place, about halfway down. Pip

Yusuf
tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, Reading a transfer error is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Mo

Delphine
tickets.reply: Hello Delphine, the request ran across dates you have blocked for the first week of December, and the approve was refusing quietly rather than saying so. That is ours and it is on the list to fix. I have approved it from this end. Callum

Kind regards,
Callie
tickets.reply: Hello Callie, rather than fight their mail filter before Monday, use a sign-in code. Clear the email on each record, press Get sign-in code and give them the six characters. They can put an address on themselves later. Dot

It is only a handful of people affected out of the whole team, and the ones it is affecting are all part time, in case that narrows it down at all. Any help appreciated.
Saoirse
tickets.reply: both of them had their email addresses corrected on their records in the last fortnight, and a change to the address signs that person out everywhere. It should settle now the records are right. Niamh

tickets.subject: URGENT - failed payment
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I have had an email saying the payment failed. The card is fine as far as I know. The bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. Can I pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? Our general manager is on leave so it has landed with me. Cheers.

Kind regards,
Diego
tickets.reply: Hi Diego, Changing the card on the account is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Tola

tickets.subject: Printing the rota
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, I want to put the rota up in the kitchen but when I print it the week runs across two pages and half of Sunday is cut off. Hope that makes sense.
Dan
tickets.reply: Hi Dan, tick Fit to one page in the print box and choose landscape, and fourteen names will go on a sheet. If the chef only wants the kitchen, filter the rota by role before you print and it comes out bigger still. Rhys

tickets.subject: How do I cancel time off
tickets.message:
evening, one of the bar team has asked to cancel the week he booked for february. how do i take it back off? i want the days back on his allowance if that is possible. thanks so much.
hugo
tickets.reply: Hi Hugo, open the booking on his record and press Cancel, leaving the days going back on ticked. The block comes off the rota straight away, but it will not put his old shifts back, so that week needs building again for him. Tola

tickets.subject: Following up: leavers?
tickets.message:
Hi there, I marked a member of staff as a leaver and she is still in the staff list! I do not want to delete her in case we need the records. She is also still on the bill by the look of it. Apologies, mid-service here. I had a reply before but it did not fix it, so here it is again with more detail.
Diego
tickets.reply: Hello Diego, have a read of A leaver who comes back and see whether it gets you where you want to be. If it does not quite fit what you are looking at, say so and I will dig into the account. Lou

tickets.subject: Still not sorted: accountant wants vat invoices
tickets.message:
Hiya, The receipts I have do not show a VAT number and I need them to. Our VAT number is on the account already I think. Year end is the end of this month. Sorry to chase, I asked about this last week and it is still happening.
Brid
tickets.reply: Hi Brid, your VAT number was not on the account, which is why they came out as receipts. I have added it from your details and rebuilt all six. They keep their original numbers and dates, so your accountant will be happy. Jonah

tickets.subject: password setup
tickets.message:
Hiya, The password page says the invitation has expired but I only sent it last week. I sent it on the day he accepted the job which was a while back now. Thanks, as always.
Yusuf
tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, The app asking you to sign in again is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Nico

tickets.subject: URGENT - what does the venue plan cost
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, We want to go on to the venue plan now rather than wait until the first. What does that cost? Happy either way, I just want to know before I press it. We are opening the second site on the twelfth. I have written it out as best I can, tell me what else you need. Anything you can do this morning would be a help.
Delphine

tickets.subject: allowance does not match
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, One of my supervisors says she has twelve days left and I make it nine. I cannot see where the difference is coming from. We moved the holiday year over not long ago, which might be it. She started partway through the year so it should be pro rata. It is happening every time, not now and then. Thank you.

Kind regards,
Struan

tickets.subject: forgot to clock out
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, Somebody has left a shift open since Saturday night and it is throwing the week out. I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. Tariq
tickets.reply: Hello Tariq, this article is the one you want: Editing hours you have already approved. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Chloe

tickets.subject: holiday figures
tickets.message:
Hiya, One of my supervisors says she has twelve days left and I make it nine. I cannot see where the difference is coming from. She started partway through the year so it should be pro rata. Thanks for reading all that.
Rehan
tickets.reply: Hi Rehan, the three days are the ones she has already booked for later in the year. Her figure counts the whole year including what is booked ahead, and yours was counting what she has taken so far. Both are right, they answer different questions. Aisha

tickets.subject: Following up: our payment bounced
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, Our monthly payment has bounced and I do not want to lose access. Can I pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? The bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. I had a reply before but it did not fix it, so here it is again with more detail.
Brid
tickets.reply: Hi Brid, A card payment that failed is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Amara

tickets.subject: putting the account on hold
tickets.message:
Hi tehre, Is there a way of putting the account on hold while we are shut? We would want the rotas still there when we come back. It is six weeks, maybe seven. For what it is worth we came off spreadsheets when we joined and nobody here has ever used anything like this before, so do tell me if I am looking in the wrong place entirely. Hope you can help.
Bethan
tickets.reply: Hi Bethan, yes, and it is built for exactly your case. Settings > Plan, press Pause, give the date you are opening again. Nothing is charged while you are shut, the rotas and hours stay readable, and it starts itself on the date you gave. Una

tickets.subject: booked on twice

Kind regards,
Zeynep
tickets.reply: Giving somebody shifts at two venues is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Finn

Hi team, I have built next week's rota and when I press publish nothing happens. The staff say they still cannot see it on their phones. Last week published fine on the Tuesday so I do not think I am doing it differently. Thanks in advance.
Saoirse
tickets.reply: Hi Saoirse, I have had a look and the week was stuck with two shifts that had no role on them, which is what the publish was waiting on. I have put a role on both and published it from this end, so your team have it now. Jade

tickets.subject: Re: No clash warning
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me. She works at both of our sites which might be why. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. I am the owner on the account so I should have the run of it. My assistant manager has tried it as well and gets exactly the same. Thanks so much.

Kind regards,
Tess
tickets.reply: Hello Tess, this is the one case the warning is quiet about: both shifts had no role on them, and the clash check counts by role. I have put roles on everything this week, so it will speak up next time. Eilidh

tickets.subject: worked and rota'd are six apart
tickets.message:
Hi there, The hours report says one hundred adn ninety two and I have added the rota up at one hundred and eighty six! Which one goes to payroll? Nobody has told me they stayed late. It has been right every other week since we started. I have looked twice and I am sure I am not imagining it. Any steer welcome. Sorry, dashing about.
Anton

tickets.subject: Bank holiday counted as a day
tickets.message:
hi team, the last bank holiday has come off two people's allowance and i do not think it should have. can i put the day back on without deleting the booking? we close on bank holidays anyway. it has been like this for three or four days now. it was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. speak soon.
yusuf
tickets.reply: Hello Yusuf, you can leave the booking alone; I have put the day back with an adjustment rather than cancelling anything. The setting is fixed as well, so it will not happen at Christmas. Aisha

tickets.subject: Do not renew us
tickets.message:
Hi team, We will not be renewing when the year is up in February! Please make sure we are not charged again and tell me what happens to the staff logins. No complaints about the desk, you have always been quick. I would like the invoices for the last year kept somewhere I can get at them. It is the sort of thing I should probably know by now. We have three of us with manager access, in case that matters. Thanks for reading all that. Written in a hurry, sorry.
Diego
tickets.reply: Hi Diego, understood, and thank you for the notice. I have set the account to close on the last day of the current period, so there is no further charge, and the invoices stay reachable from the sign-in page for twelve months. Maya

tickets.subject: Still being billed for a leaver
tickets.message:
Hi team, I marked a member of staff as a leaver and she is still in the staff list! I do not want to delete her in case we need the records. She is also still on the bill by the look of it. Nothing has changed at our end that I know of. Grateful for anything you can tell me. Sorry, one hand on the phone.
Gwen

tickets.subject: can they carry days over
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Two of the team have not taken their holiday and the year ends this month. Can they carry it over? I do not want it to just disappear on the first. We have always allowed up to five days. I have written it out as best I can, tell me what else you need. I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. Grateful for anything you can tell me.

Kind regards,
Yusuf
tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, I have set your carry limit to five days, so anything left up to that moves across on the first on its own. Nothing will be lost. If you want a date by which the carried days have to be used, say so and I will put that on too. Yasmin

tickets.subject: carry over holiday
tickets.message:
Hi team, How do I let somebody carry five days into next year? We have always allowed up to five days. I do not want it to just disappear on the first. Many thanks.
Tariq

tickets.subject: Who changed the rota
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Some of the shifts I put in on Saturday are no longer there and I have no idea where they went. Is there any way of seeing what it looked like before? My assistant manager was editing at the same time so it may be that. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Any steer welcome.

Kind regards,
Sami
tickets.reply: Hi Sami, the history has it: your assistant manager applied a template over the week at twenty past four, which cleared what was there first. I have restored the rota to twenty past three and Saturday is back as you had it. Priya

tickets.subject: charge i cannot account for
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, We have been billed twice this month by the look of the bank statement. It is dated the third which is not our usual date. The rest of it makes sense. Any help appreciated.

Kind regards,
Delphine
tickets.reply: Hi Delphine, that is the part month from when you added the second venue on the third, which is why the date looks odd. It sits next to the ordinary line for the month, so the two together are the full bill rather than two bills. Maya

tickets.subject: invite not received
tickets.message:

Lewis
tickets.reply: Hi Lewis, all three bounced: the address on her record has a full stop where an at sign should be. I have not changed it in case I guess wrong, so correct it on her record and send it once more and it will land. Aisha

Sami
tickets.reply: Hi Sami, this is covered in Bringing takings in from the till. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Wren

Saoirse
tickets.reply: Hi Saoirse, no bother at all. Have a read of Reconnecting something that stopped and follow it through from the top. It catches most people out in the same place, about halfway down. Yasmin

tickets.message:

The owner has asked me to put a case together either way by the end of the month. Clockwise Crew came to see us last week and the demo was slick, I will say that. I would rather stay if I am honest because everybody knows how it works. I wrote in about this on the 7 January and the article I was sent was not about this at all.

Kind regards,
Isobel
tickets.reply: Hi Isobel, I am sorry to hear it has got to that point. Rotas and hours both come out as a spreadsheet from the Export button on each page, and I have asked Georgia on our side to ring you about the price before you decide anything. Grace

I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. I have copied our other manager in so she can see what you say back. Hope you can help.
Gwen
tickets.reply: Hello Gwen, Correcting an allowance halfway through the year is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Rhys

tickets.subject: Missed clock out

zeynep
tickets.reply: Hello Zeynep, this article is the one you want: Missed clock-outs and how to put them right. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Dot

tickets.subject: Re: Payroll transfers stopped
tickets.message:
Hiya, Nothing has gone through to payroll since the end of last month and nobody told us. We have a payroll run on Thursday. Our old finance manager set it up and she has left. I wrote in about this on the 7 January and the article I was sent was not about this at all.

tickets.reply: you do not need her login, only your own at the payroll provider. Once you have reconnected, press Test before Thursday so you are not finding out on the night. Give me a shout if the test comes back with anything. Gus

Kind regards,
Eleri

Eleri
tickets.reply: Hi Eleri, I have sent you Pausing an account over the winter, which covers exactly this. Give it a go and let me know how you get on. Una

I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. I have got the account open in front of me if you need anything from it. I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. Cheers.
Sami
tickets.reply: Hi Sami, yes, type it in. Click the amber line on the hours page, put in the time he actually finished and give a reason. Until you do, those hours are out of the week altogether rather than counting as forty one. Lena

Hello, The wage cost report has no takings against it since Saturday. We had a new till terminal put in on Friday. The hours side is working fine. I have looked twice and I am sure I am not imagining it. I have got the account open in front of me if you need anything from it. Sorry if I have missed something obvious.
Delphine
tickets.reply: the transfer log has been refusing since Friday evening with an unknown device. That will be the terminal. Open Settings > Connections, map it to the venue, and the nights since then come in on the next run. Umar

tickets.message:

We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. The rest of the system has been very good to us, for what it is worth. Thanks so much.
Hattie

Marek

brid

Hi there, One of the team has changed her email address. Where do I update it? Will it sign her out of the app? She cannot get into the old one at all any more. I am the owner on the account so I should have the run of it. I would rather ask than make a mess of it. Let me know when you can.
Kwame
tickets.reply: Hello Kwame, this article is the one you want: Changing the email on an account. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Lena

tickets.subject: payroll connection
tickets.message:
Hiya, Nothing has gone through to payroll since the end of last month and nobody told us. Our old finance manager set it up and she has left. We have a payroll run on Thursday. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. If there is a better way of doing this I am happy to hear it. Any help appreciated.
Struan
tickets.reply: connections are signed in as a person, so it stopped when her account at the payroll end did. Open Settings > Connections and press Reconnect, signing in as yourself. Everything held since then goes on Thursday night. Gus

tickets.subject: Following up: Cancelling a booking
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I approved a week's holiday and he now wants to work it instead. The rota for that week is already published. I want the days back on his allowance if that is possible. I wrote in about this on the 28 January and the article I was sent was not about this at all.

Kind regards,
Hattie
tickets.reply: Hello Hattie, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Cancelling time off that was already approved walks through it step by step. Priya

tickets.subject: printing for the kitchen
tickets.message:
Hello again, How do I get a printed rota that fits on one sheet? The chef likes it on the wall so this matters more than it should. Landscape helps a bit but not enough with fourteen names on it. I would rather ask than make a mess of it. Happy to jump on a call if that is easier than typing it all out. Any steer welcome.
Anton
tickets.reply: Hello Anton, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Sending a rota to a spreadsheet walks through it step by step. Callum

tickets.subject: Overtime not counted
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, One of the team did fifty one hours and none of it has come out as overtime. Their contract says forty. We pay time and a quarter over that. Thanks for reading all that.
Verity
tickets.reply: Hello Verity, nobody at your venue has contracted hours set, which is why it is nought across the board. I have put the standard forty on everybody full time and left the part timers for you, since those will all be different. Callum

tickets.subject: Breaks not coming off
tickets.message:
hello again, everybody's half hour break is still in their total. i thought unpaid breaks came off automatically. it is a thirty minute break on anything over six hours. it was right at the other venue so it must be a setting. we took the second site on a while back and i have not sat down with the settings since. thanks for reading all that.

tickets.reply: Hi Zeynep, this is covered in Putting a break on a shift. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Eli

Hi team, Clock in on the app says it cannot find the venue and refuses. There is no signal in the cellar which may be part of it. The tablet on the bar works fine. It is the same on the tablet behind the bar. I have updated the app and it made no difference. Any help appreciated.
Anton
tickets.reply: Hi Anton, location is on for your venue, which is why it asks. The tablet on the bar does not use it at all, so anybody who would rather not allow it can clock in there. I can turn it off for the venue if it is causing more trouble than it saves. Abe

We close on bank holidays anyway. I should say the same thing happened a while back as well and it sorted itself out before I got round to writing in, so I do not know whether the two are connected. If there is a better way of doing this I am happy to hear it. Sorry if I have missed something obvious.

Kind regards,
Paulina
tickets.reply: Hi Paulina, no bother at all. Have a read of Bank holidays on the rota and follow it through from the top. It catches most people out in the same place, about halfway down. Will

Hugo
tickets.reply: Hi Hugo, the five were marked as leavers on the fourth, and the count is taken on the first, so they were on the books that morning. The next bill will be twenty six. I have credited the five for this month as it was days rather than weeks. Bea

tickets.reply: Hi Callie, his main venue is the second site, so the request belongs to the managers there and your button is showing but not yours to press. I have added you as a manager at both venues, which is what you want anyway. Hamid

Hello again, The team are getting rota emails at eleven at night and one of them has complained. I do the rota after service so it is my fault for publishing then, but still. Ideally it would hold them until the morning. This is the second time I am asking. Nobody came back to me last time.

tickets.reply: I have set the hold on your venue to eight in the morning. Publish when you like after service and nothing will leave until then. Anybody who opens the app before eight will still see the week, because the rota itself goes live at once. Niamh

tickets.subject: right to work document running out
tickets.message:
hi there, a visa on one of the staff records runs out in three weeks and i want to know what the system does. i do not want him coming off the rota automatically. he has applied for the new one already. i did try ringing earlier but i think i caught you at lunch, so i thought i would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. we are a small team so it is usually me doing all of this. thanks so much.
dan
tickets.reply: Hi Dan, nothing happens on the date. Nobody comes off the rota and no shift is refused; the record shows the expiry in red and you get the reminders. Upload the new document when it comes and the old one stays underneath as history. Seb

Kind regards,
Rehan

tickets.subject: same rota at both venues
