Hi, The password page says the invitation has expired but I only sent it last week. I sent it on the day he accepted the job which was a while back now. He is on shift tonight so it would be good to sort it today. It is happening every time, not now and then. Hope that makes sense.
Brid
tickets.reply: Hello Brid, that message means the link has run out rather than anything being wrong with his account. Press Invite on his record again and the new link replaces the old one. I have done it this time so he is not stuck. Yasmin

tickets.subject: Her allowance is wrong
tickets.message:
Hiya, One of my supervisors says she has twelve days left and I make it nine. I cannot see where the difference is coming from. We moved the holiday year over not long ago, which might be it. She started partway through the year so it should be pro rata. It is the sort of thing I should probably know by now. Many thanks.
Hugo

tickets.subject: Re: clash warning did not show
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, I have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. She works at both of our sites which might be why. Thanks, as always.
Aoife
tickets.reply: Hi Aoife, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Giving somebody shifts at two venues. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Nico

tickets.subject: Staff getting emails at night
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, The team are getting rota emails at eleven at night and one of them has complained. I do the rota after service so it is my fault for publishing then, but still. Ideally it would hold them until the morning. I have got the account open in front of me if you need anything from it. I do the office side and my business partner does the floor. Sorry if I have missed something obvious.

Kind regards,
Tess
tickets.reply: Hello Tess, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Who is told when a rota changes walks through it step by step. Yasmin

tickets.subject: approve button does nothing
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I cannot approve time off for one of the kitchen porters. Nothing happens at all. I can approve everybody else's, it is just his. He works at both venues if that makes a difference. It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. Nothing has changed at our end that I know of. Thanks for your time.

Kind regards,
Fraser

tickets.subject: emails at 11pm
tickets.message:
Hi there, Can we stop the system emailing staff after about nine? It went out at half past eleven on Sunday. Ideally it would hold them until the morning. Any steer welcome.
Saoirse
tickets.reply: Hello Saoirse, that is a setting rather than something you are doing wrong. It is on for you now at seven thirty, which is what most of our late-finishing venues use. Shout if you want it later. Yasmin

tickets.subject: Carrying days into next year
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, How do I let somebody carry five days into next year? We have always allowed up to five days. I do not want it to just disappear on the first. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. It is the sort of thing I should probably know by now. Hope you can help.
Fraser
tickets.reply: Hi Fraser, I have set your carry limit to five days, so anything left up to that moves across on the first on its own. Nothing will be lost. If you want a date by which the carried days have to be used, say so and I will put that on too. Esme

tickets.subject: shifts disappeared??
tickets.message:
good afternoon, half of saturday has vanished off the rota. there were six people on and now there are two. is there any way of seeing what it looked like before? my assistant manager was editing at the same time so it may be that. i did try ringing earlier but i think i caught you at lunch, so i thought i would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. many thanks.
orla

tickets.subject: Thinking of leaving
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, RotaHub have quoted us less than half of what we pay you and they do the payroll link. What can you do on price? The owner has asked me to put a case together either way by the end of the month. Clockwise Crew came to see us last week and the demo was slick, I will say that. I would rather stay if I am honest because everybody knows how it works. I have copied our other manager in so she can see what you say back. We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. Cheers.

Kind regards,
Fraser
tickets.reply: Hello Fraser, thank you for telling us rather than just going. The export is under Rota > Export and Pay > Export, one file per venue, and I have put a note on the account so nobody chases you about the renewal while you are deciding. Oona

tickets.subject: open shift on the hours page
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, Somebody has left a shift open since Saturday night and it is throwing the week out. Can I just type the right time in? I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. I have had a look through the help centre but I am going round in circles. Thanks, as always.
Rory
tickets.reply: Hello Rory, approving it is not a problem, you just have to reopen the week first. Press Reopen at the top, fix the Saturday, then approve it again. The period is not locked so there is nothing stopping you. Rosa

tickets.subject: Leaver still on the rota
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, Somebody who left in January is still coming up when I build the rota. She is also still on the bill by the look of it. I do not want to delete her in case we need the records. I should say the same thing happened a while back as well and it sorted itself out before I got round to writing in, so I do not know whether the two are connected. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
Tomas
tickets.reply: Hi Tomas, have a look at Adding a member of staff, it covers the same ground and should get you moving. Give me a shout if you are still stuck after it. Abe

tickets.subject: bar manager seeing cafe costs
tickets.message:
Hello, One of the managers has access to a venue she does not run. She has not done anything with it, I just noticed. Can I limit her to one venue? I have looked twice and I am sure I am not imagining it. It is happening every time, not now and then. Thanks in advance.
Kwame
tickets.reply: Hi Kwame, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: What managers can see. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Ben

tickets.subject: Rate applied to the whole week
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I gave somebody a rise from the Wednesday and the whole week has gone through at the new rate. It is only about eleven pounds but I would rather it were right. Payroll has not run yet so I can still fix it. We took the second site on a while back and I have not sat down with the settings since. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Cheers.

Kind regards,
Maddy
tickets.reply: Hi Maddy, this is covered in Different rates at different venues. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Aisha

tickets.subject: Who gets the requests
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, Holiday requests from the cafe staff are coming to me and they should be going to the cafe manager. She cannot see them at all at the moment which is the bigger problem. Ta.
Hattie
tickets.reply: Hello Hattie, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Who a holiday request goes to walks through it step by step. Chloe

tickets.subject: On two shifts at once?
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, It let me put one of the girls on a bar shift and a kitchen shift at the same time and did not say anything. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. Let me know when you can.

Kind regards,
Rory
tickets.reply: Hello Rory, Time off that lands on a bank holiday is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Bea

tickets.subject: Nobody gets told about the rota
tickets.message:
hello, half teh team get the push and half do not. they are mostly on android. i have checked and notifications are on in their settings. the rest of the system has been very good to us, for what it is worth. it is happening every time, not now and then. thanks for your time.
tariq

tickets.subject: invite not received?
tickets.message:
Hi, I have invited a new starter three times and she says nothing has come through. It is a hotmail address if that means anything. She has checked spam. Any steer welcome.
Aoife
tickets.reply: Hi Aoife, no bother at all. Have a read of An invitation that never arrived and follow it through from the top. It catches most people out in the same place, about halfway down. Quinn

tickets.subject: upgrading the plan
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, If I change plan today am I paying for both this month? Happy either way, I just want to know before I press it! We are opening the second site on the twelfth. There are two of us who do the rota so it may be worth telling us both. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. Let me know when you can. Sorry, dashing about.
Rory
tickets.reply: Hello Rory, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Reading the charges on your statement walks through it step by step. Mo

tickets.subject: unused days
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Two of the team have not taken their holiday and the year ends this month. Can they carry it over? I do not want it to just disappear on the first. We have always allowed up to five days. I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. Let me know when you can.

Kind regards,
Brid
tickets.reply: Hi Brid, this is covered in Carrying holiday into next year. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Rosa

tickets.subject: limiting a manager to one venue
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, My bar manager can see the wage costs for the cafe adn she should only see the bar. Can I limit her to one venue? She has not done anything with it, I just noticed. Happy to jump on a call if that is easier than typing it all out. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Speak soon.
Kofi
tickets.reply: Hello Kofi, Giving somebody shifts at two venues is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Amara

tickets.subject: Changing somebody's email
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I need to change the email on a staff record and I cannot find the field. She cannot get into the old one at all any more. Will it sign her out of the app? I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. Any help appreciated.

Kind regards,
Callie
tickets.reply: Hi Callie, it is on her staff record under Contact; you have to press Edit at the top before the field will take a change, which is the bit everybody misses. It will sign her out on her phone, so warn her before you do it mid-shift. Dev

tickets.subject: Cancelling a booking
tickets.message:
Hello, I approved a week's holiday and he now wants to work it instead. The rota for that week is already published. I want the days back on his allowance if that is possible. My assistant manager is the one who usually deals with this and she is off. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Thanks for your time.
Yusuf
tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, open the booking on his record and press Cancel, leaving the days going back on ticked. The block comes off the rota straight away, but it will not put his old shifts back, so that week needs building again for him. Seb

tickets.subject: Invitation link expired
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Our new bartender clicks the link in his email and it says the link is no longer valid. He is on shift tonight so it would be good to sort it today. I sent it on the day he accepted the job which was a while back now. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Thanks for your time.

Kind regards,
Sami
tickets.reply: Hi Sami, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Inviting a member of staff by email. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Grace

tickets.subject: Re: Transfer failed overnight
tickets.message:
Hello again, The transfer log has a red line against Tuesday and no explanation I can follow. Everything else in the log looks normal. It says something about a period being locked. My assistant manager is the one who usually deals with this and she is off. It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. Thanks for reading all that.
Sami

tickets.subject: our payment bounced
tickets.message:
hello hollins, i have had an email saying the payment failed. the card is fine as far as i know. the bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. can i pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? if there is a better way of doing this i am happy to hear it. appreciate it.
isobel
tickets.reply: Changing the card on the account is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Niamh

tickets.subject: breaks and hours
tickets.message:
Hi team, The break time is being paid and it should not be. It was right at the other venue so it must be a setting. It is a thirty minute break on anything over six hours. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Our general manager is on leave so it has landed with me. Appreciate it.
Tess
tickets.reply: Hi Tess, Taking a venue off the bill is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Priya

tickets.subject: URGENT - holiday figures
tickets.message:
Hello, The allowance on the staff record does not match what I have written down. We moved the holiday year over not long ago, which might be it. She started partway through the year so it should be pro rata. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Let me know when you can.
Hattie
tickets.reply: Hello Hattie, have a read of Correcting an allowance halfway through the year and see whether it gets you where you want to be. If it does not quite fit what you are looking at, say so and I will dig into the account. Dot

tickets.subject: Re: Saturday shifts have gone
tickets.message:
Hiya, Half of Saturday has vanished off the rota. There were six people on and now there are two. My assistant manager was editing at the same time so it may be that. Is there any way of seeing what it looked like before? This is the second time I am asking. Nobody came back to me last time.
Aoife
tickets.reply: Hi Aoife, Getting back a shift you deleted is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Petra

tickets.subject: leaver still on the rota
tickets.message:
Evening, I marked a member of staff as a leaver and she is still in the staff list. She is also still on the bill by the look of it. I do not want to delete her in case we need the records. I have looked twice and I am sure I am not imagining it. Any steer welcome.
Eleri
tickets.reply: Hi Eleri, this is covered in What counts as an active member of staff. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Rhys

tickets.subject: Overtime missing
tickets.message:
hello again, one of the team did fifty one hours and none of it has come out as overtime. their contract says forty. we pay time and a quarter over that. i would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. it was working the week before, which is why it stands out. please can somebody have a look.
tomas
tickets.reply: Hi Tomas, his staff record has no contracted hours on it, so there is no figure for the overtime to start above. I have put forty on his record and the eleven hours have come through. Worth checking the rest of the team while you are in there. Lou

tickets.subject: matching screen shows her twice
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Somebody appears twice on the matching screen and I do not know which to pick. Her hours have not gone through for two weeks now. I would rather not break the other one. My assistant manager has tried it as well and gets exactly the same. I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. Appreciate it.
Eleri
tickets.reply: Hi Eleri, have a look at Moving down a plan, it covers the same ground and should get you moving. Give me a shout if you are still stuck after it. Wren

tickets.subject: Hours report does not add up
tickets.message:
good evening, worked hours and rota'd hours are six apart this week and i cannot see why. it has been right every other week since we started. nobody has told me they stayed late. plese can somebody have a look.
meera
tickets.reply: Hello Meera, this article is the one you want: Where the hours on a payslip come from. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Zach

tickets.subject: Re: signing in?
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, One of the waitresses has a new phone and the app will not let her in. They can get in on the website on a laptop. It started this week as far as I know. I have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. I have updated the app and it made no difference. Sorry to chase, I asked about this last week and it is still happening.

Kind regards,
Hugo
tickets.reply: Hi Hugo, Approving a holiday request is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Tola

tickets.subject: import failing
tickets.message:
Hi, Our payroll people say the file will not import. They said something about the date column. I can send you the file if that helps. It worked last month with the same people. Appreciate it.
Kofi
tickets.reply: Hi Kofi, two of your new starters have no payroll reference on their staff records, and a blank reference is what their end refuses on. Put the two references in and rebuild the file and it will go. Grace

tickets.subject: No overtime showing at all
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Overtime is showing as zero for everybody this week which cannot be right. We pay time and a quarter over that. Their contract says forty. We took the second site on a while back and I have not sat down with the settings since. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. Let me know when you can.

Kind regards,
Elin
tickets.reply: Hi Elin, I have sent you The warning when a shift goes over contracted hours, which covers exactly this. Give it a go and let me know how you get on. Niamh

tickets.subject: Old android phone
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, One of our KPs has an old android phone and the app closes as soon as it opens. He does not want a new phone and I do not blame him. Is there anything else he can use? I have looked twice and I am sure I am not imagining it. I should say the same thing happened a while back as well and it sorted itself out before I got round to writing in, so I do not know whether the two are connected. Thanks for reading all that.

Kind regards,
Aoife
tickets.reply: nothing he can do about the app itself, but bookmark the website on his home screen and it behaves much like the app. He will see his rota the moment it is published, same as everybody else. Niamh

tickets.subject: Requests for a venue I do not run
tickets.message:
Good morning, I am getting requests for a venue I do not run. It started when we added teh second site in January. She cannot see them at all at the moment which is the bigger problem. My assistant manager is the one who usually deals with this and she is off. It has been like this for three or four days now. Grateful for anything you can tell me.
Tariq
tickets.reply: Hello Tariq, she was set up as a manager but with no venue ticked, so she could see nothing. I have ticked the cafe on her permissions and the four requests waiting are in her list now. Will

tickets.subject: Card declined
tickets.message:
hello again, i have had an email saying the payment failed. the card is fine as far as i know. can i pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? the bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. we have been with you long enough that i should know this, i am sure. my assistant manager has tried it as well and gets exactly the same. many thanks.
meera
tickets.reply: Hello Meera, yes, you can pay it now: open Settings > Billing and press Retry against the failed line. If the bank blocked it as a new payee it usually goes through on the second try once you have told them to expect it. Callum

tickets.subject: App keeps signing people out
tickets.message:
Hi, The app signs me out every couple of days and I have to put teh password in again. It is not the end of the world but it is putting people off using it. Both on iphones. I have updated the app and it made no difference. It was working the week before, which is why it stands out. Grateful for anything you can tell me.
Elin
tickets.reply: Hello Elin, Changing the day your rota week starts on is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Cerys

tickets.subject: bank holiday booking
tickets.message:
Hi, Somebody booked the bank holiday Monday off and it has taken a whole day off her allowance. She does not normally work Mondays. We close on bank holidays anyway. Can I put the day back on without deleting the booking? I have copied our other manager in so she can see what you say back. Thanks in advance.
Rehan
tickets.reply: Hi Rehan, the day was not marked as observed in your venue settings, so it counted as an ordinary Monday. I have marked all eight for this year and put the day back on both allowances. Bookings you make from now on will skip them. Chloe

tickets.subject: Error on last night's run
tickets.message:
Hi there, The transfer log has a red line against Tuesday and no explanation I can follow. It says something about a period being locked. Everything else in the log looks normal. Nothing has changed at our end that I know of. I do the office side and my business partner does the floor. Speak soon.
Delphine

tickets.subject: manager permissions
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, My bar manager can see the wage costs for the cafe and she should only see the bar. She has not done anything with it, I just noticed. Can I limit her to one venue? It is the sort of thing I should probably know by now. It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. Thanks so much.

Kind regards,
Ciaran
tickets.reply: Hi Ciaran, Turning a holiday request down is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Rosa

tickets.subject: URGENT - app not staying signed in
tickets.message:
Hi there, Two of the supervisors are being asked to sign in again most mornings. It is not the end of the world but it is putting people off using it. Both on iphones. I have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. Happy to jump on a call if that is easier than typing it all out. Anything you can do this morning would be a help.
Aoife

tickets.subject: Re: rota stuck on draft
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I have built next week's rota and when I press publish nothing happens. The staff say they still cannot see it on their phones. I have tried it in Chrome and in Edge and it does the same in both. Last week published fine on the Tuesday so I do not think I am doing it differently. It was working the week before, which is why it stands out. It is happening every time, not now and then. Thanks so much.

Kind regards,
Elin
tickets.reply: Hello Elin, that was ours and I am sorry about it. Publishing was timing out for venues with more than thirty on the rota for about an hour this morning. It is fixed and your week has gone out. Nothing needed doing at your end. Will

tickets.subject: new email for one of the team
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I need to change the email on a staff record and I cannot find the field. She cannot get into the old one at all any more. Will it sign her out of the app? Our general manager is on leave so it has landed with me. I have copied our other manager in so she can see what you say back. Grateful for anything you can tell me.

Kind regards,
Yusuf
tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, it is on her staff record under Contact; you have to press Edit at the top before the field will take a change, which is the bit everybody misses. It will sign her out on her phone, so warn her before you do it mid-shift. Mo

tickets.subject: URGENT - carrying days into next year
tickets.message:
Hello again, How do I let somebody carry five days into next year? I do not want it to just disappear on the first! We have always allowed up to five days. Thanks so much. Excuse the typing, I am on the floor.
Aoife
tickets.reply: Hello Aoife, Missed clock-outs and how to put them right is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Eli

tickets.subject: Extra charge on the statement
tickets.message:
Hello, There is a charge on the statement for eighteen pounds that I cannot account for. The rest of it makes sense. It is dated the third which is not our usual date. I have got the account open in front of me if you need anything from it. It is only a handful of people affected out of the whole team, and the ones it is affecting are all part time, in case that narrows it down at all. Any help appreciated.
Kofi

tickets.subject: URGENT - what does the venue plan cost
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, If I change plan today am I paying for both this month? We are opening the second site on the twelfth. Happy either way, I just want to know before I press it. We are a small team so it is usually me doing all of this. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Kind regards,
Rory

tickets.subject: calendar link
tickets.message:
hello, the rota in my calendar is showing last week's shifts. i published the new one on monday. everybody else seems fine. i subscribed to the link about a year ago. it has been like this for three or four days now. there are two of us who do the rota so it may be worth telling us both. appreciate it.
aoife
tickets.reply: thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Putting the rota in a calendar walks through it step by step. Cal

tickets.subject: payroll connection
tickets.message:
Hi team, Nothing has gone through to payroll since the end of last month and nobody told us. Our old finance manager set it up and she has left. We have a payroll run on Thursday. This started sometime last week I think. It is happening every time, not now and then. Grateful for anything you can tell me.
Tomas
tickets.reply: Hi Tomas, connections are signed in as a person, so it stopped when her account at the payroll end did. Open Settings > Connections and press Reconnect, signing in as yourself. Everything held since then goes on Thursday night. Jade

tickets.subject: Same rota at both venues
tickets.message:
Hello, We run two sites and the rota is nearly the same at both! Can I copy a week from one to the other rather than typing it twice? It is about twenty minutes a week I would rather not spend. The staff are different at each but the shape of the week is identical. Sorry if this is a daft question. I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. Any steer welcome. Short one, sorry, we are slammed.
Saoirse
tickets.reply: Hi Saoirse, copy week works within a venue rather than across two, but a template saved as the shape only does exactly what you want. Save one off your main site and apply it at the other, then drop the names on. Priya

tickets.subject: unpaid breaks
tickets.message:
Hi team, Everybody's half hour break is still in their total. I thought unpaid breaks came off automatically. It was right at the other venue so it must be a setting. It is a thirty minute break on anything over six hours. It has been like this for three or four days now. For what it is worth we came off spreadsheets when we joined and nobody here has ever used anything like this before, so do tell me if I am looking in the wrong place entirely. Thanks in advance.
Brid
tickets.reply: Hi Brid, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Unpaid breaks and how they come off the total. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Bea

tickets.subject: clash warning did not show
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me. She works at both of our sites which might be why. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. This started sometime last week I think. I have written it out as best I can, tell me what else you need. Thanks so much.

Kind regards,
Marek
tickets.reply: Hi Marek, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: The warning when somebody is on twice. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Priya

tickets.subject: Cannot find the venue
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Clock in on the app says it cannot find the venue and refuses! There is no signal in the cellar which may be part of it. Hope you can help. Short one, sorry, we are slammed.
Fraser
tickets.reply: Hello Fraser, this article is the one you want: Location and clocking in. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Bea

tickets.subject: invites and nothing back

ines

tickets.message:

Bethan
tickets.reply: Hi Bethan, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Moving down a plan. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Eilidh

tickets.reply: Hello Rory, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Running rotas for more than one venue walks through it step by step. Eilidh

tomas
tickets.reply: this is covered in What counts as an active member of staff. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Gus

orla
tickets.reply: Hi Orla, I have set the hold on your venue to eight in the morning. Publish when you like after service and nothing will leave until then. Anybody who opens the app before eight will still see the week, because the rota itself goes live at once. Jade

It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. Speak soon.
Marek
tickets.reply: Hi Marek, that is the part month from when you added the second venue on the third, which is why the date looks odd. It sits next to the ordinary line for the month, so the two together are the full bill rather than two bills. Mo

hiya, the app signs me out every couple of days and i have to put the password in again. it is not the end of the world but it is putting people off using it. both on iphones. i have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. it has been like this for three or four days now. many thanks.
diego
tickets.reply: Hi Diego, both of them had their email addresses corrected on their records in the last fortnight, and a change to the address signs that person out everywhere. It should settle now the records are right. Callum

tickets.subject: Can I reuse a week at both sites
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, We run two sites and the rota is nearly the same at both. Can I copy a week from one to the other rather than typing it twice? The staff are different at each but the shape of the week is identical. It is about twenty minutes a week I would rather not spend. If there is a better way of doing this I am happy to hear it. We are a small team so it is usually me doing all of this. Thanks, as always.

Kind regards,
Hugo
tickets.reply: I have saved a template for you off last week at the first site and made it available at both, so it is there the next time you open Templates. Drop the names on afterwards and it should be five minutes rather than twenty. Dev

tickets.subject: payroll cannot read the file
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, The export comes out but payroll cannot read it and I am running out of time before the cut off. I can send you the file if that helps. It worked last month with the same people. It was working the week before, which is why it stands out. It has been like this for three or four days now. Grateful for anything you can tell me.
Sami
tickets.reply: Hello Sami, your provider changed how they want dates at the start of the month. I have switched the date layout on your connection to the one they are now asking for and rebuilt the file, which is attached. You should make the cut off. Sana

tickets.subject: Limiting a manager to one venue?
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, One of the managers has access to a venue she does not run. She has not done anything with it, I just noticed. Can I limit her to one venue? It has been like this for three or four days now. If there is a better way of doing this I am happy to hear it. Hope that makes sense.

Kind regards,
Diego
tickets.reply: Hi Diego, I have sent you What managers can see, which covers exactly this. Give it a go and let me know how you get on. Wren

tickets.subject: bank holiday booking
tickets.message:
Hiya, The last bank holiday has come off two people's allowance and I do not think it should have. Can I put teh day back on without deleting the booking? We close on bank holidays anyway. I should say the same thing happened a while back as well and it sorted itself out before I got round to writing in, so I do not know whether the two are connected. Ta.
Ines
tickets.reply: Hi Ines, have a look at Marking somebody as a leaver, it covers the same ground and should get you moving. Give me a shout if you are still stuck after it. Amara

tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I want to put the rota up in the kitchen but when I print it the week runs across two pages and half of Sunday is cut off. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Ta.

Kind regards,
Maddy
tickets.reply: Hello Maddy, have a read of Printing a rota for the back of house and see whether it gets you where you want to be. If it does not quite fit what you are looking at, say so and I will dig into the account. Farah

tickets.reply: Hi Joss, this is covered in A card payment that failed. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Quinn

tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Somebody who left in February is still coming up when I build the rota! She is also still on the bill by the look of it. Thanks for your time. Short one, sorry, we are slammed.
Orla

tickets.subject: Re: Open shift on the hours page
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Somebody has left a shift open since Saturday night and it is throwing the week out. Can I just type the right time in? I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. I would rather ask than make a mess of it. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Thank you.

Kind regards,

tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Approving the week's hours. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Hamid

tickets.subject: On two shifts at once
tickets.message:
hi, sorry to bother you again, i have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me. i thought there was meant to be a warning for that. she works at both of our sites which might be why. for what it is worth we came off spreadsheets when we joined and nobody here has ever used anything like this before, so do tell me if i am looking in the wrong place entirely. thanks, as always.
paulina
tickets.reply: the warning was there but it is on the other venue's rota, not yours, because the second shift was at the second site. It is a red corner on that week. I have shortened the kitchen shift by two hours so the two no longer overlap. Kit

tickets.subject: Invitation link expired
tickets.message:
Afternoon, The password page says the invitation has expired but I only sent it last week. He is on shift tonight so it would be good to sort it today. Please can somebody have a look.
Rehan
tickets.reply: Hello Rehan, that message means the link has run out rather than anything being wrong with his account. Press Invite on his record again and the new link replaces the old one. I have done it this time so he is not stuck. Sana

tickets.subject: Re: Invitation never arrived
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, Two new people have not had their invitation emails and they start Monday. It is a hotmail address if that means anything. She has checked spam. Nothing has changed at our end that I know of. The rest of the system has been very good to us, for what it is worth. Let me know when you can.
Anton
tickets.reply: Hi Anton, all three bounced: the address on her record has a full stop where an at sign should be. I have not changed it in case I guess wrong, so correct it on her record and send it once more and it will land. Aisha

tickets.subject: changing a rate from a date
tickets.message:
hello hollins, how do i change a rate from a particular day rather than from now? payroll has not run yet so i can still fix it. it is only about eleven pounds but i would rather it were right. i have written it out as best i can, tell me what else you need. thanks so much.
kofi
tickets.reply: Hi Kofi, no bother at all. Have a read of Editing hours you have already approved and follow it through from the top. It catches most people out in the same place, about halfway down. Mo

tickets.message:
hi there, i have published next week but one of the chefs says his app is empty. everybody else can see theirs. he has pulled down to refresh and it made no difference. it has been like this for three or four days now. i have updated the app and it made no difference. sorry if i have missed something obvious.
saoirse
tickets.reply: Hello Saoirse, this article is the one you want: Signing in to the app. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Marcus

tickets.message:
hiya, i have an email saying last night's transfer failed with an error adn i do not understand what it means. it says something about a period being locked. everything else in the log looks normal. it was working the week before, which is why it stands out. it was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. please can somebody have a look.
marek
tickets.reply: Hi Marek, the period had been locked before the corrections went, so the transfer had nowhere to put them. I have unlocked it, the run has gone through, and I have locked it again behind me. Nothing is missing at the payroll end. Fay

tickets.subject: no takings since Saturday
tickets.message:
Hello, Till figures have stopped coming in and the percentage is useless without them. We had a new till terminal put in on Friday. The hours side is working fine. Let me know when you can.
Joss
tickets.reply: Hi Joss, the new terminal is a new device as far as the till system is concerned, so it was sending takings we had nothing to map them to. I have mapped it to your venue and pulled Saturday onwards back in. The percentage should read properly now. Mo

tickets.subject: Missed clock out
tickets.message:
Hello again, Somebody has left a shift open since Saturday night and it is throwing the week out. I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. Can I just type the right time in? We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. Happy to jump on a call if that is easier than typing it all out. Sorry if I have missed something obvious.
Tariq
tickets.reply: Hi Tariq, yes, type it in. Click the amber line on the hours page, put in the time he actually finished and give a reason. Until you do, those hours are out of the week altogether rather than counting as forty one. Rhys

tickets.subject: forgot to clock out
tickets.message:

Kind regards,
Marek
tickets.reply: Hi Marek, yes, type it in. Click the amber line on the hours page, put in the time he actually finished and give a reason. Until you do, those hours are out of the week altogether rather than counting as forty one. Dot

evening, somebody has left a shift open since saturday night and it is throwing the week out. can i just type the right time in? i have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. speak soon.
saoirse

tickets.subject: How do I cancel time off
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, One of the bar team has asked to cancel the week he booked for April. How do I take it back off? I want the days back on his allowance if that is possible. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Kind regards,
Zeynep
tickets.reply: Hi Zeynep, open the booking on his record and press Cancel, leaving the days going back on ticked. The block comes off the rota straight away, but it will not put his old shifts back, so that week needs building again for him. Niamh

tickets.subject: next week missing on the app
tickets.message:
Evening, The app shows this week but nothing for next, and the rota is definitely published. He has pulled down to refresh and it made no difference. Everybody else can see theirs. It is the same on the tablet behind the bar. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Thank you.
Struan
tickets.reply: Hi Struan, he is on next week's rota at the second venue rather than yours, and the app shows him both, so his week is not empty here. Ask him to swipe once more; I suspect he is looking at the week after next. Dot

tickets.subject: carry over holiday
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Two of the team have not taken their holiday and the year ends this month. Can they carry it over? I do not want it to just disappear on the first. We have always allowed up to five days. Sorry if this is a daft question. I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. Any steer welcome.

Kind regards,
Orla
tickets.reply: Hi Orla, I have set your carry limit to five days, so anything left up to that moves across on the first on its own. Nothing will be lost. If you want a date by which the carried days have to be used, say so and I will put that on too. Dot

aoife
tickets.reply: Hi Aoife, on Android it is nearly always battery saving, which is set per app rather than for the phone. Ask them to take the app out of battery saving and the pushes come through. That is why it is half of them and not all. Rhys

tickets.reply: Hi Ola, Rota history and who changed what is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Rhys

tickets.subject: putting the account on hold
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Is there a way of putting the account on hold while we are shut? It is six weeks, maybe seven! We would want the rotas still there when we come back. My assistant manager is the one who usually deals with this and she is off. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Thanks for your time. Written in a hurry, sorry.
Marek
tickets.reply: Hi Marek, yes, and it is built for exactly your case. Settings > Plan, press Pause, give the date you are opening again. Nothing is charged while you are shut, the rotas and hours stay readable, and it starts itself on the date you gave. Rhys

tickets.reply: Hello Struan, this article is the one you want: The payroll file and what is in each column. I have had a quick look at your account as well and everything on our side looks as it should. Kat

tickets.subject: card declined
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Our monthly payment has bounced and I do not want to lose access. Can I pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? The bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. It was fine before, it has only started since the weekend. It was working the week before, which is why it stands out. Many thanks.

Kind regards,
Orla
tickets.reply: Hello Orla, yes, you can pay it now: open Settings > Billing and press Retry against the failed line. If the bank blocked it as a new payee it usually goes through on the second try once you have told them to expect it. Esme

tickets.reply: Hi Struan, location is on for your venue, which is why it asks. The tablet on the bar does not use it at all, so anybody who would rather not allow it can clock in there. I can turn it off for the venue if it is causing more trouble than it saves. Zach

tickets.subject: Payroll transfers stopped

tickets.reply: Hi Brid, connections are signed in as a person, so it stopped when her account at the payroll end did. Open Settings > Connections and press Reconnect, signing in as yourself. Everything held since then goes on Thursday night. Grace

hello, holiday requests from teh cafe staff are coming to me and they should be going to the cafe manager. she cannot see them at all at the moment which is the bigger problem. it started when we added the second site in february. the rest of the system has been very good to us, for what it is worth. i do the office side and my business partner does the floor. thanks, as always.
isobel
tickets.reply: Hi Isobel, Who a holiday request goes to is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Kat

tickets.subject: App will not let her in
tickets.message:
Evening, Three of the team cannot get into the app. It says the email or password is wrong and they are sure it is not. It started this week as far as I know. They can get in on the website on a laptop. I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. Cheers.
Dan
tickets.reply: Hello Dan, her new phone is on an old version of the app from the phone shop's restore. Ask her to update it in the App Store and sign in again. If it still refuses, press Send reset on her record and she can set a new password. Oona

tickets.subject: Open shift on the hours page
tickets.message:
Hi, One of the chefs forgot to clock out on Friday and his shift is still showing as running! It says forty one hours. Can I just type the right time in? I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. Ta. Apologies, mid-service here.
Brid

tickets.subject: closing for a few weeks
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, Is there a way of putting the account on hold while we are shut? We would want the rotas still there when we come back. It is six weeks, maybe seven. Sorry if this is a daft question. Our general manager is on leave so it has landed with me. Hope you can help.
Meera
tickets.reply: Hi Meera, yes, and it is built for exactly your case. Settings > Plan, press Pause, give the date you are opening again. Nothing is charged while you are shut, the rotas and hours stay readable, and it starts itself on the date you gave. Ben

tickets.subject: Overtime not counted
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Overtime is showing as zero for everybody this week which cannot be right. Their contract says forty. We pay time and a quarter over that. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. I would rather not have to ring in the middle of service. Thanks for your time.
Marek
tickets.reply: Hi Marek, Contracted hours and how to set them is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Oona

tickets.subject: Shifts not showing on the app
tickets.message:
hi team, i have published next week but one of the chefs says his app is empty. he has pulled down to refresh and it made no difference. everybody else can see theirs. i have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. everything else on the phone seems to be fine, it is only this. let me know when you can.
dan
tickets.reply: Hi Dan, have a look at Approving a holiday request, it covers the same ground and should get you moving. Give me a shout if you are still stuck after it. Ben

tickets.subject: Old android phone
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, The app will not install on one of the team's phones, it says it is not compatible. He does not want a new phone and I do not blame him. Appreciate it.
Dan
tickets.reply: Hi Dan, Getting the app on a phone is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Kit

tickets.subject: duplicate record
tickets.message:
Hello again, One of the kitchen team is in payroll under her married name and in here under her old one, and the transfer keeps refusing her. I would rather not break the other one. Her hours have not gone through for two weeks now. We have three of us with manager access, in case that matters. Thanks for reading all that.
Anton
tickets.reply: Hi Anton, match ours to whichever one payroll is actually paying, then mark the other as not in payroll so it stops coming back at you. Putting her payroll reference on her staff record here will keep the two tied together from now on. Petra

tickets.subject: notifications
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Nobody gets a notification when I publish. They only find out if they open the app. They are mostly on android. I have checked and notifications are on in their settings. I have got the account open in front of me if you need anything from it. I have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. Thanks for your time.

Kind regards,
Hugo
tickets.reply: Hi Hugo, on Android it is nearly always battery saving, which is set per app rather than for the phone. Ask them to take the app out of battery saving and the pushes come through. That is why it is half of them and not all. Quinn

tickets.subject: Rota emails going out late at night?
tickets.message:
Hiya, Can we stop the system emailing staff after about nine? It went out at half past eleven on Sunday. Ideally it would hold them until the morning. I do the rota after service so it is my fault for publishing then, but still. I am fairly new to running the rota here, so apologies if this is obvious. Cheers.
Zeynep
tickets.reply: Hello Zeynep, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Stopping rota emails going out at night walks through it step by step. Callum

tickets.subject: Paying for leavers
tickets.message:
Hiya, This month's bill counts thirty one people and we only have twenty six. I marked them all as leavers in February. Can that be put right on the next bill? Thanks for your time.
Joss
tickets.reply: Hi Joss, the five were marked as leavers on the fourth, and the count is taken on the first, so they were on the books that morning. The next bill will be twenty six. I have credited the five for this month as it was days rather than weeks. Yasmin

tickets.message:

Brid
tickets.reply: Hello Brid, the carry runs overnight on the first day of the new year, so setting it before then is all you need to do. It is on for you now at five days. Farah

Gwen

tickets.message:

Lewis
tickets.reply: Hello Lewis, the link is live and showing this week when I open it here, so it is your calendar's refresh rather than the rota. Some of them only look once a day. Forcing a refresh in the calendar app will bring it straight down. Tola

tickets.subject: printing for the kitchen
tickets.message:
Hello again, I want to put the rota up in the kitchen but when I print it the week runs across two pages adn half of Sunday is cut off! The chef likes it on the wall so this matters more than it should. Landscape helps a bit but not enough with fourteen names on it. Any steer welcome. Sorry to be brief.
Paulina
tickets.reply: Hi Paulina, tick Fit to one page in the print box and choose landscape, and fourteen names will go on a sheet. If the chef only wants the kitchen, filter the rota by role before you print and it comes out bigger still. Grace

tickets.subject: Following up: api key
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, We need to change the API key our reporting uses. What happens to the old one? There is only the one thing using it. It runs at about three in the morning. Sorry to chase, I asked about this last week and it is still happening.

Kind regards,
Ines

tickets.subject: Missed clock out
tickets.message:
Hi there, Somebody has left a shift open since Saturday night and it is throwing the week out. Can I just type the right time in? I have already approved the week which may have been a mistake. Ta.
Ines
tickets.reply: Hi Ines, yes, type it in. Click the amber line on the hours page, put in the time he actually finished and give a reason. Until you do, those hours are out of the week altogether rather than counting as forty one. Grace

tickets.subject: Card not working
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Our monthly payment has bounced and I do not want to lose access. The bank has probably stopped it, they do that with anything new. Can I pay it now rather than wait for it to try again? For what it is worth we came off spreadsheets when we joined and nobody here has ever used anything like this before, so do tell me if I am looking in the wrong place entirely. Whatever you can tell me is more than I know at the moment. Thanks for your time.
Anton
tickets.reply: the reason back from the bank is expired card, so a new one is the fix rather than trying the same one again. Put it on under Settings > Billing and press Retry. Nothing stops working in the meantime. Finn

tickets.subject: Error on last night's run
tickets.message:
hiya, i have an email saying last night's transfer failed with an error and i do not understand what it means. everything else in the log looks normal. it says something about a period being locked. it is the sort of thing i should probably know by now. i have asked our area manger and she did not know either. any help appreciated.
lewis

tickets.subject: Nightly transfer failed
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, The transfer log has a red line against Tuesday and no explanation I can follow. Everything else in the log looks normal. It says something about a period being locked. We have three of us with manager access, in case that matters. I am the owner on the account so I should have the run of it. Thanks, as always.

Kind regards,
Maddy
tickets.reply: Hi Maddy, the period had been locked before the corrections went, so the transfer had nowhere to put them. I have unlocked it, the run has gone through, and I have locked it again behind me. Nothing is missing at the payroll end. Esme

tickets.subject: Can they carry days over
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Two of the team have not taken their holiday and the year ends this month. Can they carry it over? I do not want it to just disappear on the first. We have always allowed up to five days. There are two of us who do the rota so it may be worth telling us both. Happy to jump on a call if that is easier than typing it all out. Thank you.

Kind regards,
Gwen

tickets.message:

Can I put the day back on without deleting the booking? We took the second site on a while back and I have not sat down with the settings since. The rest of the system has been very good to us, for what it is worth. Thanks in advance.
Fraser
tickets.reply: Hello Fraser, you can leave the booking alone; I have put the day back with an adjustment rather than cancelling anything. The setting is fixed as well, so it will not happen at Christmas. Will

tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I have built next week's rota and when I press publish nothing happens. The staff say they still cannot see it on their phones. I have tried it in Chrome and in Edge and it does the same in both. Last week published fine on the Tuesday so I do not think I am doing it differently. I have written it out as best I can, tell me what else you need. My assistant manager is the one who usually deals with this and she is off. Let me know when you can.

Kind regards,
Tess
tickets.reply: that was ours and I am sorry about it. Publishing was timing out for venues with more than thirty on the rota for about an hour this morning. It is fixed and your week has gone out. Nothing needed doing at your end. Finn

tickets.reply: Hello Yusuf, thanks for the detail, that helped narrow it down. Location and clocking in walks through it step by step. Maya

It is the sort of thing I should probably know by now. We are in the middle of a refurb and the office wifi has been in and out all week, so I did wonder whether that had anything to do with it, but the tills are fine. Hope that makes sense.

Kind regards,
Delphine

tickets.subject: Being asked to sign in again?
tickets.message:

Hugo
tickets.reply: Hi Hugo, both of them had their email addresses corrected on their records in the last fortnight, and a change to the address signs that person out everywhere. It should settle now the records are right. Chloe

tickets.subject: allowance does not match
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, The allowance on the staff record does not match what I have written down. She started partway through the year so it should be pro rata. Kind regards,
Verity
tickets.reply: Hi Verity, the three days are the ones she has already booked for later in the year. Her figure counts the whole year including what is booked ahead, and yours was counting what she has taken so far. Both are right, they answer different questions. Ivy

ines

hi team, two of the team have not taken their holiday adn the year ends this month. can they carry it over? we have always allowed up to five days. i do not want it to just disappear on the first. i would rather ask than make a mess of it. we are a small team so it is usually me doing all of this. cheers.

tickets.subject: Still being billed for a leaver
tickets.message:
Morning, I marked a member of staff as a leaver and she is still in the staff list. She is also still on the bill by the look of it. I do not want to delete her in case we need the records. The rest of the system has been very good to us, for what it is worth. Sorry if I have missed something obvious.
Paulina
tickets.reply: Hi Paulina, her record was saved with the leaver box ticked but no last day, so nothing took effect. I have put her last day on it. She is off the rota from the day after and off next month's bill. Marcus

tickets.subject: Same person twice across the two systems
tickets.message:
Hello again, One of the kitchen team is in payrol under her married name and in here under her old one, and the transfer keeps refusing her. Her hours have not gone through for two weeks now. I would rather not break the other one. Sorry if this is a daft question. There are two of us who do the rota so it may be worth telling us both. Appreciate it.
Ola

tickets.subject: Same rota at both venues
tickets.message:
Hi there, We run two sites and the rota is nearly the same at both. Can I copy a week from one to the other rather than typing it twice? It is about twenty minutes a week I would rather not spend. The staff are different at each but the shape of the week is identical. Please can somebody have a look.
Nadia
tickets.reply: Hi Nadia, copy week works within a venue rather than across two, but a template saved as the shape only does exactly what you want. Save one off your main site and apply it at the other, then drop the names on. Yasmin

tickets.subject: emails at 11pm
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Can we stop the system emailing staff after about nine? It went out at half past eleven on Sunday. I do the rota after service so it is my fault for publishing then, but still. Ideally it would hold them until the morning. I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. I have asked our area manager and she did not know either. Any steer welcome.

Kind regards,
Joss
tickets.reply: Hello Joss, Adding a member of staff is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Abe

tickets.subject: New starter cannot set a password
tickets.message:
Good morning, The password page says the invitation has expired but I only sent it last week. He is on shift tonight so it would be good to sort it today. I sent it on the day he accepted the job which was a while back now. We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. There are two of us who do the rota so it may be worth telling us both. Hope that makes sense.
Tariq
tickets.reply: Hi Tariq, an invitation is good for fourteen days and his went out five weeks ago, which is all that is wrong. I have sent him a fresh one just now; it will be in his inbox and he can set a password before tonight. Priya

tickets.subject: charge i cannot account for
tickets.message:
Good morning, There is a charge on the statement for eighteen pounds that I cannot account for! The rest of it makes sense. It is dated the third which is not our usual date. My assistant manager is the one who usually deals with this and she is off. Our general manager is on leave so it has landed with me. Many thanks. Sorry, one hand on the phone.
Rory
tickets.reply: Hi Rory, that is the part month from when you added the second venue on the third, which is why the date looks odd. It sits next to the ordinary line for the month, so the two together are the full bill rather than two bills. Petra

tickets.message:

It is the sort of thing I should probably know by now. Hope you can help.

Kind regards,
Tariq

tickets.subject: How do I cancel time off?
tickets.message:

Saoirse
tickets.reply: Hi Saoirse, open the booking on his record and press Cancel, leaving the days going back on ticked. The block comes off the rota straight away, but it will not put his old shifts back, so that week needs building again for him. Abe

tickets.subject: Carrying days into next year
tickets.message:
Good afternoon, How do I let somebody carry five days into next year? We have always allowed up to five days. I do not want it to just disappear on the first. I would rather ask than make a mess of it. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. Thanks in advance.
Anton
tickets.reply: I have set your carry limit to five days, so anything left up to that moves across on the first on its own. Nothing will be lost. If you want a date by which the carried days have to be used, say so and I will put that on too. Cal

tickets.subject: Re: Invitation email missing
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Two new people have not had their invitation emails and they start Monday. She has checked spam. It is a hotmail address if that means anything. Hope you can help.

Kind regards,
Nadia

tickets.subject: Re: Which hours go to payroll
tickets.message:
hello hollins, worked hours and rota'd hours are six apart this week and i cannot see why. it has been right every other week since we started. nobody has told me they stayed late. any help appreciated.
maddy
tickets.reply: Hello Maddy, this week has two open cover shifts on the Friday that nobody was ever put on. They count in the rota'd column with nobody on them, which is your six hours. Take them off and the two columns agree. Yasmin

tickets.subject: Breaks not coming off
tickets.message:

Kofi
tickets.reply: Hi Kofi, you are right, it is a setting, and this venue has breaks as paid while the other has them unpaid. I have changed it. It will not go back and change weeks you have already published, so this week is the first one it affects. Jade

Dear Hollins Rota support, We shut from the end of June until March. Can we pause rather than pay for three months of nothing? We did this last year by email and it worked fine.

Kind regards,
Diego
tickets.reply: yes, a pause is there for exactly this. I have set it from the end of the month to the first of March; nothing is charged in between and everything is as you left it when it comes back on. Niamh

Orla

brid

Diego
tickets.reply: Hi Diego, she started partway through the holiday year, so her first year is pro rata from her start date, and that is where the difference is. I have put the working out on her record as a note so you can show it to her. Ivy

tickets.reply: Hi Dan, yes, and it is built for exactly your case. Settings > Plan, press Pause, give the date you are opening again. Nothing is charged while you are shut, the rotas and hours stay readable, and it starts itself on the date you gave. Rhys

Marek

Lewis

Gwen

Joss

Kwame

kwame

tickets.message:

Kofi

tickets.subject: Pausing while we are closed
tickets.message:
Hi team, Is there a way of putting the account on hold while we are shut? It is six weeks, maybe seven. We would want the rotas still there when we come back.
Dan
tickets.reply: Hi Dan, yes, and it is built for exactly your case. Settings > Plan, press Pause, give the date you are opening again. Nothing is charged while you are shut, the rotas and hours stay readable, and it starts itself on the date you gave. Ben

tickets.subject: URGENT - push notifications not arriving
tickets.message:
Hi there, Half the team get the push and half do not. They are mostly on android. I have checked and notifications are on in their settings. I have updated the app and it made no difference. Sorry to push but I need this sorted before the weekend.
Tess
tickets.reply: Hello Tess, your venue has notifications held until eight in the morning, so a rota published in the evening goes out then rather than at once. I can move or remove the hold if you would rather they went straight away. Amara

tickets.subject: app signing out
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Two of the supervisors are being asked to sign in again most mornings. It is not the end of the world but it is putting people off using it. Both on iphones. I have tried it on two different phones and they both do exactly the same. We are in the middle of a refurb and the office wifi has been in and out all week, so I did wonder whether that had anything to do with it, but the tills are fine.

Kind regards,
Meera
tickets.reply: Hello Meera, if it is still happening after a week, ask them to sign out properly once and back in rather than letting it drop out. That clears an old sign-in that keeps being refused, which is usually what is behind it. Will

Bethan
tickets.reply: Hello Bethan, the request ran across dates you have blocked for the first week of December, and the approve was refusing quietly rather than saying so. That is ours and it is on the list to fix. I have approved it from this end. Jonah

callie

tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, Nothing has gone through to payroll since the end of last month and nobody told us. We have a payroll run on Thursday. Our old finance manager set it up and she has left.

Kind regards,
Rory
tickets.reply: Hi Rory, connections are signed in as a person, so it stopped when her account at the payroll end did. Open Settings > Connections and press Reconnect, signing in as yourself. Everything held since then goes on Thursday night. Eilidh

tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, The team are getting rota emails at eleven at night and one of them has complained. Ideally it would hold them until the morning. I do the rota after service so it is my fault for publishing then, but still.

Kind regards,
Tomas
tickets.reply: Hello Tomas, that is a setting rather than something you are doing wrong. It is on for you now at seven thirty, which is what most of our late-finishing venues use. Shout if you want it later. Kieran

tickets.message:

Kind regards,
Nadia
tickets.reply: Hi Nadia, the worked column is what goes to payroll. The six hours are three people clocking out between twenty and forty minutes after their shift on the Saturday. The clock-ins are on the lines if you want to look before you approve it. Mo

aoife

lewis

tickets.subject: Who gets the requests
tickets.message:
Hi there, Holiday requests from the cafe staff are coming to me and they should be going to the cafe manager! She cannot see them at all at the moment which is the bigger problem. It started when we added the second site in July. Excuse the typing, I am on the floor.
Isobel
tickets.reply: Hello Isobel, have a read of Keeping a manager to one venue and see whether it gets you where you want to be. If it does not quite fit what you are looking at, say so and I will dig into the account. Amara

tickets.subject: Limiting a manager to one venue
tickets.message:
Hello, My bar manager can see the wage costs for the cafe and she should only see the bar! She has not done anything with it, I just noticed. Can I limit her to one venue? Sorry, dashing about.
Isobel
tickets.reply: Hi Isobel, Offering a shift to the whole team is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Bea

tickets.subject: URGENT - pause us over the winter
tickets.message:
Afternoon, Seasonal place, nobody on the rota until spring. What are the options other than cancelling and starting again? We did this last year by email and it worked fine. Anything you can do this morning would be a help.
Rehan
tickets.reply: Hello Rehan, yes, a pause is there for exactly this. I have set it from the end of the month to the first of March; nothing is charged in between and everything is as you left it when it comes back on. Dara

tickets.subject: App will not let her in
tickets.message:
Hi, Three of the team cannot get into the app. It says the email or password is wrong and they are sure it is not. It started this week as far as I know. They can get in on the website on a laptop. It is the same whether I do it on the laptop or on my phone.
Kwame
tickets.reply: thanks for getting in touch. The steps are all in this one: Signing in on a new phone. Work down it and you should be there in a couple of minutes. Come back to me if it still will not behave and I will take a look at the account myself. Imogen

tickets.subject: not compatible
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, One of our KPs has an old android phone and the app closes as soon as it opens. Is there anything else he can use? He does not want a new phone and I do not blame him. It is the same on the tablet behind the bar. It is the same whether I do it on the laptop or on my phone.
Orla

tickets.subject: URGENT - allowance does not match
tickets.message:
evening, one of my supervisors says she has twelve days left and i make it nine. i cannot see where the difference is coming from. we moved the holiday year over not long ago, which might be it. she started partway through the year so it should be pro rata. we open at five so ideally before then.
rehan
tickets.reply: Hello Rehan, Allowance in days and allowance in hours is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Seb
